findings.body:
The loop range was changed to 0..xs.len() while the body still indexes xs[i + 1]. On the final iteration i = len-1, so xs[i + 1] is xs[len], which is out of bounds. Any non-empty slice therefore panics, including a single-element slice where i = 0 reads xs[1].

Trigger: Calling pair_sums with any slice of length 1 or more.

Impact: pair_sums panics on every non-empty input. Callers get a crash instead of the adjacent-pair sums. Only the empty input returns normally.
findings.suggestion: Use `for i in 0..xs.len().saturating_sub(1)` or `xs.windows(2).map(|w| w[0] + w[1]).collect()`.
findings.title: pair_sums indexes xs[i + 1] past the end on the last iteration and panics for any non-empty input

risk_level.reason: The new loop runs i over 0..len and indexes xs[i + 1], which panics out of bounds on the last iteration, and the commit message says it only changes pairing direction, so the behaviour change is unannounced.
